tables.sectionText:
PRIZES AND ODDS

During the hourly drawing1, five winning dice symbols2 will be selected. Prizes3 and odds vary depending upon the number of dice symbols matched.

Match	Prize	Odds
5	$1,000	1 in 7,776
4	$55	1 in 311
3	$5	1 in 31.1
2	$1	1 in 6.2


Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 5.1

DISCLAIMERS:

1 Money Roll can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:50 AM and the last drawing at 11:50 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for matching 5 dice with 5X multiplier drawn is $100,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. The prize amount per share is, $100,000 divided by total winning bets. The prize amount per winner is, the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
MONEY ROLL
Step 1,
Pick Your Dice

This game is Quick Pick only. Five dice symbols will be randomly generated for you.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Each play costs $1. You also have the option to add Super Bonus for $1 to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your Quick Pick dice symbols on it.

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match two or more dice on your ticket in the same position as the drawn dice.
